name: Managed Session Context Rail Prototype
scenario: Find and continue the latest Managed Codex session from the Web Console context rail.
ownerSurface: Right rail: context, history, and governance
visualQaTasks: Confirm latest Managed Codex session appears in the right rail.
Confirm session turns and Add follow-up appear in session detail, not in the task composer.
Confirm task composer does not contain Evidence Center, Import evidence, raw JSONL, hook names, or integration builder controls.
Confirm task input, status, latest session, and needs attention stack without overlap on mobile.
Confirm long session titles and result summaries wrap without pushing run controls.
